description: Search the shadcn/ui blocks listed on shadcn.exchange: ready-made sections of a page, such as heroes, pricing tables, login forms, dashboards, footers and FAQs, from every public shadcn registry, free and paid. Use it when the user is building a page or a screen with shadcn/ui and wants a section to start from, or asks what blocks exist for something. Results come best first. Each has its id (for get_block), its description, its install command if it is free or where to buy it if it is paid, and its page with a live preview. Every word of the query has to be in a block's name, title, description or registry, so use one or two words, and the category for the kind of section.

category.description: The kind of section, from list_categories, such as hero, pricing, login, dashboard or footer.

limit.description: How many results to return, up to 50.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for the next page.

price.description: free: blocks that install now with one command. paid: blocks their registries sell. any: both.

query.description: One or two words to find, such as "pricing", "sign in", "testimonials" or "bento". Leave it out to list a category or a registry.

registry.description: Only this registry's blocks: its id from list_registries, such as efferd or shadcnblocks.

name: search_blocks
title: Search shadcn/ui blocks
